fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready: cycle close 2026-11-04
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-03 11:30 to 2026-11-04 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: no new escalations from this cycle's runs. Waiting on you:
- bc6bc746 (srs-web#691, raised 11-04): may the group build the Read/Lenses "open the dedicated editor" button, when srs-web UI is outside the builder's mandate? Options: widen the mandate for this one issue, or leave it to another group. Action needed: decide. Urgency: low-medium (it is the only unclaimed ready item in the group).
- 21b6b4b7 (srs#236, P0): field identity and naming rules are in the spec but nothing enforces them. Options: enforce in the schema, enforce in a validator, or stop claiming them. Action needed: decide. Urgency: medium (the P0 cannot move). Waiting 5 days.
- 864eaebf (srs#991, already merged): one heading-outline rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition. Action needed: decide/ratify. Urgency: low.
- c7a8e0a2 (srs-rust#1497, already merged): may `note delete` refuse notes that Relations point at? Ratification only.
Also needs-input: srs-rust#1491, #683, srs#928.

2. Decided within mandate: nothing ratified. No builder-proposed decision was ready, so no session was held. Merged PRs this cycle cite already ratified decisions (bf4a5af5, 00567bf1, RFC-049).

3. Done: 8 group PRs merged, all by the owner account (their GitHub token also performs auto-merge, so the log cannot tell a hand merge from an auto one). Quorum lines (builder / reviewer / mandate):
- srs-rust#1561 structured diagnostics on render, find, container view and more: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / decision bf4a5af5 (approve at eb7c4eb)
- srs-rust#1563 diagnosticsStructured on record transition warnings: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / charter 00567bf1 (approve at afce1cb)
- srs-rust#1569 structured diagnostics beside the package export notes: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / bf4a5af5 + ADR-057, Door 1 (approve at badeb8c)
- srs-rust#1548 RFC-049 core Address and registry: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / RFC-049, owner-merge (reviewer: reject, escalation; breaking wire change)
- srs-rust#1551 MCP over a registry of repositories: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / RFC-049 (last verdict reject, gates not shown: stacked on #1548)
- srs-rust#1549 type-inheritance I-39..I-42 reported at Type level: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / charter, Door 1 (last verdict reject, red Test; your ruling 11-03: dangling extendsTypeId is advisory)
- srs-rust#1552 refuse type create/update that repo validate rejects: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / charter, Door 1 (last verdict reject, red Schema Drift)
- srs-rust#1535 reproduction test for out-of-enum fieldMeta.source (#1528): owner-merge, no quorum line

4. Stuck or lost: 2 group PRs open.
- srs-rust#1562 vocabulary create runs the V5 check: reviewer rejected, CI Test red on the head (not pre-existing on master).
- srs#998 RFC-053 (Draft): gate:owner-merge, awaiting your merge.
Five of the eight merged PRs (#1548, #1551, #1549, #1552, #1535) carry a reviewer "reject" or no quorum line as their last verdict and were merged by you after your rulings; no later approve comment exists, so their quorum lines record rejection, not assent. All have reviewer findings lists.

5. Budget: 3 of 10 delegated merges counted for this cycle by the quorum lines that carry approve (#1561, #1563, #1569; the other five were owner merges or overrides); 2 open. group-state for the new cycle (opened 11:30): merged 0, open 1, room 9. Pause state: running (the 11-02 and 11-03 reports both carry a thumbs up).
5b. Awaiting ratification: c7a8e0a2 (7 days), 864eaebf (5 days), 21b6b4b7 (5 days), bc6bc746 (today). Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready + wg:third-party-ready in srs-rust, srs, srs-vscode, srs-web: 4 open issues (srs-rust 1, srs 2, srs-vscode 0, srs-web 1), all priority P2: srs-rust#1496; srs#931, #928 (RFC needed); srs-web#691. Top 3 in builder order (no local priorities, priority then oldest): srs#931, srs#928, srs-rust#1496. Open group PRs in flight: 2; budget left 9. **Queue running dry: 4 ready (two need an RFC, one is outside the mandate, bc6bc746), budget 10. Needs feeding.** New work could come from the analyst, the spec-to-implementation drift list, open exercises. Waits on you: the four decisions in 1. Fed by the analyst: 2026-10-23 (nominated 3, filed 1); no run since.
6b. Exercises (the group's own, none listed in the SemanticOps log): dd1a47a7 "Relation reads hide who asserted a link"; 7131fe89 "Substrate entries: spec contract and schemas disagree". Build trigger: logs hold well over 10 ratified decisions, so srs-web#560 is still ready to unpark; your call.

7. What we learned: the structured-diagnostics train (#1339) finished three slices in one cycle under one ratified decision, which is what a standing mandate should do. Against that, five PRs reached master on your rulings after reviewer rejections with no later approve, so the quorum record and the merge log disagree; a re-review comment after an owner ruling would close the gap. The queue emptied faster than the analyst refills it. Measurement e32746fe (I1): the window opens at this close, so it reads 0 of 0 grounded; a close-time read is always near empty. Useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
fieldValues.rationale: No new escalations were raised from this cycle's runs: the open drafts (21b6b4b7, 864eaebf, c7a8e0a2) are unchanged and bc6bc746 (srs-web#691 mandate question) was raised today; all are listed in section 1. Reviewer rejections on RFC-049 and the type-validation PRs were resolved by owner rulings, not by new decisions.
fieldValues.figures: merged 3 of 10 delegated (+5 owner merges/overrides); open 2; running
